name: KY-011 two-colour LED (5 mm)
not_buildable: Each colour needs a series resistor and an output pin. It is an output part, and LearnLens sketches may only switch the board's own LEDs so far.
identification: Small black PCB with 3 angled header pins at one end and a milky white 5 mm LED with three legs, bent to point away from the board. The KY-029 is the same with a smaller LED.

facts.statement: Red and green LED with a common cathode; forward voltage 2.0 V to 2.5 V at 20 mA. The vendor lists a series resistor of 120 ohm at 3.3 V.
facts.source: Joy-IT SensorKit, KY-011, technical data and series resistors
